description: Smoke scenarios the Test-McpEndpoint.ps1 runner executes against the .NET MCP transport. Each scenario names the MCP tool, declares the default argument bag, and (for preview tools) the structural diff field that must come back empty. The baseline tool inventory is the source of truth for tools/list parity; if the .NET backend adds or removes a tool the runner fails (or, without -FailOnUnapproved, records the drift in migration/actual/mcp-smoke-report.json).

scenarios.name: discover-tools-list
scenarios.notes: The runner also calls tools/list directly to enforce inventory parity against baselineToolNames.

scenarios.name: read-get-ontology
scenarios.notes: Read the TBox for the seeded knowledge system. The runner never logs the response body; only the success/failure shape reaches the report.

scenarios.name: read-search-concepts
scenarios.notes: Read-side vocabulary search. Confirms the search tool accepts an empty/default argument bag without surfacing an MCP error envelope.

scenarios.name: preview-release-clean
scenarios.notes: preview_release must surface an empty `unapproved_diff` array when the seeded draft matches the live ontology. Any entry here is treated as an unapproved difference.

scenarios.name: apply-release-idempotent
scenarios.notes: Side-effect tool. The runner asserts a result envelope is returned; it does NOT inspect the body to avoid leaking release identifiers into the report.
